Frequently asked questions
Who can participate? How do I invite friends?
All registered Qoder users can become inviters. Open the campaign page and share your exclusive invite link. Your friend can participate once they register for the first time through your link and an effective referral relationship is established.
How many Credits can I earn by inviting friends?
Complete the tasks below and you will earn the corresponding rewards. The three tiers stack:
Successfully start at least 1 task or conversation within 7 days of registration: 50 Credits; successfully start at least 1 task or conversation on each of 3 days within 7 days of registration: 100 Credits; complete your first subscription purchase within 30 days of registration: you receive 1,000 Credits and your friend receives 500 Credits.
What counts as completing a usage task? How is the 3-day total calculated?
Successfully sending a task request or conversation message counts as one use, based on system records. Logging in or creating a blank conversation alone does not count. The 3 days must fall within 7 days of registration, with at least one use on each day. Multiple uses on the same day do not count as multiple days, and the days do not need to be consecutive.
Does buying a credit pack count as a first purchase? Do I need to complete the usage tasks first?
Credit packs do not count. The first-purchase reward applies only to the first successful purchase of an eligible subscription plan within 30 days of registration. The first-purchase task is calculated independently, so you do not need to complete the first-use or 3-day usage tasks beforehand.
When will rewards be credited?
Rewards for first use and 3-day usage are credited on the 8th day after registration is completed, provided the tasks are completed. The first-purchase rewards for both parties are credited 14 days after the first purchase succeeds.
How many friends can I invite at most?
Each referrer can invite up to 50 new users to sign up and take part in the follow-up tasks, and the three tasks share these 50 slots. A slot is taken as soon as your friend signs up, and it is not released even if they never complete the follow-up tasks. New users beyond this limit no longer count toward your campaign rewards.
